    10	/-!
    11	# THE SEED-LEVEL WIDENED GATE: geometry produces a `DivFamZarAff` class
    12	
    13	Roadmap leaves `AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-d.ddr.certificate.cert-assemble` /
    14	`…cert-collapse`, on the widened (R2) carrier of protection I-0492.
    15	
    16	## The gap this closes, measured rather than asserted
    17	
    18	At `a41644c36` the widened layer had thirty files and, by declaration reference:
    19	
    20	* exactly **two** of them mentioned `ThetaGeneratorSeed` — `…AffFibre.lean` (obligation 4(i))
    21	  and `…AffSeedEndpoint.lean` (the over-`R` endpoint) — and **neither** produced
    22	  `IsLocallyCertifiedAff` or `DivFamZarAff`;
    23	* crossed the other way, **zero** files mentioning `IsLocallyCertifiedAff`/`DivFamZarAff`
    24	  mentioned `ThetaGeneratorSeed`.
    25	
    26	So the only producers of a widened *value* were `mapAlg` of an existing one and the trivial
    27	one-member glue: **nothing turned geometry into a widened class.**  The chart-typed lane has
    28	that join twice — `ThetaGeneratorSeed.isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_exists_certified_adaptation`
    29	(`DivSchemeCertZarPointwise.lean:162`) and `…isLocallyCertified_of_forall_away_certified`
    30	(`DivSchemeCertZarSeed.lean:115`).  This file supplies the widened counterparts, so a DD-R
    31	consumer restated on `divFunctorAff` (`DivRepGlobalAffLift.lean`) has something to consume.
    32	
    33	## Why the composition is not a restatement, and where the work actually was
    34	
    35	The over-`R` endpoint `exists_isCertified_of_seed_of_swallowing_affineOpen` returns
    36	`∃ Dc A, A.IsCertified n` — an adaptation of `D.localEquations hD` **over `R` itself**.  The
    37	pointwise assembler `isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_forall_prime_certified_adaptation` wants, at each
    38	prime, a certificate over `Localization.Away r` for the **pulled** system.  Those are different
    39	statements and there is no `ThetaGeneratorSeed` base change in this project, so the away route
    40	would need the seed's fibre datum transported to a localized base — machinery nobody has built.
    41	
    42	The composition below avoids needing it, and the reason is the shape of `IsLocallyCertifiedAff`
    43	rather than any new geometry: `CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff.isLocallyCertifiedAff`
    44	(`…AffGlueZarKit.lean:575`) already witnesses the predicate at the **trivial one-member cover**
    45	`g = ![1]`, where `Localization.Away (1 : R)` receives the system by `mapAlg` and the required
    46	`DivEq` is reflexivity.  So an over-`R` certificate is *already* a local one, and the seed
    47	endpoint is exactly an over-`R` certificate.  No away-base seed transport is required for this
    48	direction — which is the honest reason this lands in a session rather than a wave.
    49	
    50	**What that does and does not buy.** It gives the widened lane a producer from geometry, which
    51	it did not have.  It does **not** make the away-localized route unnecessary: a seed whose
    52	degree datum is only available *after* shrinking the base still needs the per-prime form, and
    53	that form is the general `isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_forall_prime_certified_adaptation` — stated,
    54	landed, and still without a seed-level producer.  The two `_of_forall_prime` variants below take
    55	the per-prime certificate as a hypothesis for exactly that reason; they are the widened
    56	counterparts of the chart-typed gate's shape, not a discharge of it.
    57	
    58	## The obligations, still visible
    59	
    60	Nothing here hides an obligation inside a `LocalEquations` (protection I-0492 clause 4):
    61	
    62	* obligation 4(i), fibrewise-finite support, does **not** appear — it is discharged from the
    63	  seed by `ThetaGeneratorSeed.affAdaptation_fibre_regular` (`…AffFibre.lean`), inside the
    64	  endpoint;
    65	* the subordinate Stacks `0B8B` input is the explicit `hW`/`hsub`/`hWle` triple, assumed per
    66	  I-0492 clause 2;
    67	* the degree datum is the explicit `hrank`, read at the swallowing piece.
    68	
    69	## What IS still chart-typed here, measured and stated rather than glossed
    70	
    71	Note before re-checking any of this: the table below **names** the constants it reports absent, so
    72	`grep FinCoverData` on this file returns hits from the claim itself (inbox `I-0717`: an
    73	absence-claim docstring breaks the grep that would verify it). That is harmless *here* only because
    74	the measurement is a **declaration-dependency closure**, which reads proof terms and cannot see a
    75	comment. Re-verify it the same way, not with a text search.
    76	
    77	A declaration-closure probe (the calibrated form of ADDENDUM 10 §10.3 — controls
    78	`FinCoverData.toAffCoverData` / `.toChartTyping`, both of which fire) reports for
    79	`divFamZarAff_of_swallowing_affineOpen` (closure 4780) and `divFunctorAffSection` (4887):
    80	
    81	| probe | in closure? |
    82	|---|---|
    83	| `FinCoverData`, `FinCoverData.mk` | **no** |
    84	| `ChartTyping` | **no** |
    85	| `relCover_sup` | **no** |
    86	| `AffCoverData` | yes (the widened carrier — expected) |
    87	| `relPinnedChart` | **YES**, and only through `ThetaGeneratorSeed` |
    88	
    89	So the honest reading, in both directions:
    90	
    91	* **The certificate side is chart-free.** No `FinCoverData`, no `ChartTyping`, and in particular
    92	  no `relCover_sup` — which matters specifically, because `relCover_sup` is the step that turned
    93	  "misses `V₀`" into "lies inside `V₁`", i.e. the exact mechanism the refuted fixed-pair repair
    94	  depended on (spec ADDENDUM 3 §2).  Nothing here can reconstruct it: the cover has `m` pieces and
    95	  no distinguished pair.
    96	* **The SEED is not chart-free, and that is not something this file fixes.**
    97	  `ThetaGeneratorSeed` (`DivSchemeFamily.lean:74`) has fields `side : relCurve C R → Bool` and
    98	  `h : ∀ z, Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π (side z))`, so its pieces *are* basic opens of
    99	  the pinned charts.  Its `LocalEquations` cover therefore consists of chart-typed pieces even
   100	  though the certificate's cover does not.
   101	
   102	This is a genuine limit on the claim, not a violation of I-0492 clause 3, and the difference is
   103	worth being precise about.  Clause 3 forbids the *certificate clauses* from requiring the pieces
   104	to lie in a fixed pair of charts — that is what made the per-piece statement upgrade to a chart
   105	statement, and that is gone.  What remains is that the *input datum* this project happens to
   106	produce systems from is chart-indexed; the widened route consumes it without ever needing the
   107	containment, which is why the subordinate `0B8B` open `W` is an arbitrary affine open with no
   108	relation to `V₀`/`V₁`.  A chart-free seed notion would remove the last occurrence, and no consumer
   109	of this file needs one.
   110	
   111	## Main declarations
   112	
   113	* `AlgebraicGeometry.ThetaGeneratorSeed.isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_swallowing_affineOpen` — the
   114	  gate: seed + `0B8B` + degree ⟹ `IsLocallyCertifiedAff`.
   115	* `AlgebraicGeometry.ThetaGeneratorSeed.divFamZarAff_of_swallowing_affineOpen` — **the class**,
   116	  the object a widened DD-R consumer receives.
   117	* `AlgebraicGeometry.ThetaGeneratorSeed.isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_forall_prime_certified_adaptation`
   118	  and `…divFamZarAff_of_forall_prime_certified_adaptation` — the seed-level per-prime forms,
   119	  the widened counterparts of `DivSchemeCertZarPointwise.lean:162`/`:181`.
   120	* `AlgebraicGeometry.ThetaGeneratorSeed.picClass_divFamZarAff_of_swallowing_affineOpen` — the
   121	  class's Picard class is the system's, so the Abel hook DAT-C consumes it unchanged.
   122	-/
   123	
   124	set_option autoImplicit false
   125	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
   126	/- `lake env lean` drops the lakefile's `[leanOptions]` (I-0161), so the pinned synthesis
   127	depth must be set in-file for the faithful per-file check. -/
   128	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

   130	universe u

   132	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite TensorProduct
   133	
   134	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
   135	
   136	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
   137	
   138	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   139	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
   140	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi] {a : ℕ}
   141	variable {K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R pi a)}
   142	
   143	namespace ThetaGeneratorSeed
   144	
   145	variable {D : ThetaGeneratorSeed C R pi a K}
   146	
   147	/-! ## From an over-`R` widened certificate to the widened pin -/
   148	
   149	/-- **A widened certificate over `R` is a widened local certificate**, for the seed's own
   150	system.  Bridging lemma: `CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff.isLocallyCertifiedAff` witnesses the pin at
   151	the one-member cover `g = ![1]`, and a cover/adaptation/certificate triple over `R` is exactly
   152	a `CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff`.
   153	
   154	This is the widened counterpart of `isLocallyCertified_of_isCertified`
   155	(`DivSchemeCertZarSeed.lean:150`), and like it, it is a genuine weakening in the useful
   156	direction: a global certificate suffices, and the per-prime form remains available for a
   157	divisor whose degree datum only appears after shrinking the base. -/
   158	theorem isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_isCertified [IsProper C.hom] [IsNoetherianRing R] {n : ℕ}
   159	    (hD : D.IsGenerator)
   160	    (h : ∃ (Dc : AffCoverData C R) (A : AffAdaptation Dc (D.localEquations hD)),
   161	      A.IsCertified n) :
   162	    IsLocallyCertifiedAff n (D.localEquations hD) := by
   163	  obtain ⟨Dc, A, hA⟩ := h
   164	  exact CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff.isLocallyCertifiedAff
   165	    (⟨D.localEquations hD, Dc, A, hA⟩ : CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff C R n)
   166	
   167	/-! ## The gate -/
   168	
   169	/-- **THE SEED-LEVEL WIDENED GATE.**  From a theta-generator seed, the subordinate Stacks
   170	`0B8B` input, and the degree datum at the swallowing piece, the seed's local-equation system is
   171	**widened**-locally certified in degree `n`.
   172	
   173	Every hypothesis is one protection I-0492 names, and none of them is a chart:
   174	
   175	* `hW`/`hsub`/`hWle` — the subordinate `0B8B` input, an affine open `W ⊇ supp d` inside one
   176	  member of `d.cover` (clause 2: USE, do not re-derive);
   177	* `hrank` — the degree datum, read at the piece that swallows the support (clause 4's honest
   178	  residue; it cannot come from anywhere else).
   179	
   180	Obligation 4(i) is absent because it is *discharged*: `affAdaptation_fibre_regular` supplies it
   181	from the seed at every widened cover and adaptation, inside
   182	`exists_isCertified_of_seed_of_swallowing_affineOpen`.
   183	
   184	**No hypothesis on `|P¹(k)|` occurs here or on the route** — that is the field-uniformity R2 was
   185	chosen for over a field-size hypothesis (I-0492's "WHY R2"). -/
   186	theorem isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_swallowing_affineOpen [IsProper C.hom] [IsNoetherianRing R]
   187	    {n : ℕ} (hD : D.IsGenerator)
   188	    {W : (relCurve C R).Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
   189	    (hsub : (D.localEquations hD).supportLocus ⊆ (W : Set (relCurve C R)))
   190	    (z₀ : relCurve C R) (hWle : W ≤ (D.localEquations hD).cover.opens z₀)
   191	    (hrank : ∀ (Dc : AffCoverData C R) (A : AffAdaptation Dc (D.localEquations hD))
   192	      (j₀ : Dc.index),
   193	      (D.localEquations hD).supportLocus ⊆ (Dc.pieces j₀ : Set (relCurve C R)) →
   194	      (∀ j : Dc.index, j ≠ j₀ →
   195	        Disjoint (D.localEquations hD).supportLocus (Dc.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R))) →
   196	      ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, Module.rankAtStalk (R := R) (A.colength j₀) p = n) :
   197	    IsLocallyCertifiedAff n (D.localEquations hD) :=
   198	  isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_isCertified hD
   199	    (exists_isCertified_of_seed_of_swallowing_affineOpen C R hD hW hsub z₀ hWle hrank)
   200	
   201	/-- **The `DivFamZarAff` class of a seed certified on an affine open** — the object a widened
   202	DD-R consumer receives.  This is the widened counterpart of
   203	`divFamZar_of_forall_prime_away_certified` (`DivSchemeCertZarPointwise.lean:181`), and it is the
   204	first producer of a widened class from geometry rather than from another widened class. -/
   205	noncomputable def divFamZarAff_of_swallowing_affineOpen [IsProper C.hom] [IsNoetherianRing R]
   206	    {n : ℕ} (hD : D.IsGenerator)
   207	    {W : (relCurve C R).Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
   208	    (hsub : (D.localEquations hD).supportLocus ⊆ (W : Set (relCurve C R)))
   209	    (z₀ : relCurve C R) (hWle : W ≤ (D.localEquations hD).cover.opens z₀)
   210	    (hrank : ∀ (Dc : AffCoverData C R) (A : AffAdaptation Dc (D.localEquations hD))
   211	      (j₀ : Dc.index),
   212	      (D.localEquations hD).supportLocus ⊆ (Dc.pieces j₀ : Set (relCurve C R)) →
   213	      (∀ j : Dc.index, j ≠ j₀ →
   214	        Disjoint (D.localEquations hD).supportLocus (Dc.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R))) →
   215	      ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, Module.rankAtStalk (R := R) (A.colength j₀) p = n) :
   216	    DivFamZarAff C R n :=
   217	  DivFamZarAff.mk (D.localEquations hD)
   218	    (isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_swallowing_affineOpen hD hW hsub z₀ hWle hrank)
   219	
   220	/-- **The Picard class of the gate's output is the system's own.**  Recorded because it is what
   221	makes the class *usable*: DAT-C's Abel hook reads `picClass`, and it must not depend on which
   222	widened cover certified the system.  It does not — `DivFamZarAff.picClass_mk` is `rfl`. -/
   223	@[simp]
   224	theorem picClass_divFamZarAff_of_swallowing_affineOpen [IsProper C.hom] [IsNoetherianRing R]
   225	    {n : ℕ} (hD : D.IsGenerator)
   226	    {W : (relCurve C R).Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
   227	    (hsub : (D.localEquations hD).supportLocus ⊆ (W : Set (relCurve C R)))
   228	    (z₀ : relCurve C R) (hWle : W ≤ (D.localEquations hD).cover.opens z₀)
   229	    (hrank : ∀ (Dc : AffCoverData C R) (A : AffAdaptation Dc (D.localEquations hD))
   230	      (j₀ : Dc.index),
   231	      (D.localEquations hD).supportLocus ⊆ (Dc.pieces j₀ : Set (relCurve C R)) →
   232	      (∀ j : Dc.index, j ≠ j₀ →
   233	        Disjoint (D.localEquations hD).supportLocus (Dc.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R))) →
   234	      ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, Module.rankAtStalk (R := R) (A.colength j₀) p = n) :
   235	    (divFamZarAff_of_swallowing_affineOpen hD hW hsub z₀ hWle hrank).picClass
   236	      = (D.localEquations hD).picClass :=
   237	  rfl
   238	
   239	/-! ## The per-prime forms
   240	
   241	These are the widened counterparts of the chart-typed gate at
   242	`DivSchemeCertZarPointwise.lean:162`/`:181`.  They take the away-localized certificate as a
   243	HYPOTHESIS: no seed base change exists in this project, so a producer at this shape still owes
   244	the transport.  Stated at the seed rather than at a bare system so that a caller holding a seed
   245	does not have to unfold `D.localEquations hD` to use the general assembler. -/
   246	
   247	/-- **The seed-level per-prime widened gate.**  At every prime of the base it suffices to
   248	produce an away localization carrying a certified WIDENED adaptation of the pulled seed system.
   249	
   250	Contrast the gate above: this form is the one to use when the degree datum only becomes
   251	available after shrinking the base, which is the situation the support tube produces.  What it
   252	does not do is discharge the away-base fibre transport — that is the hypothesis. -/
   253	theorem isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_forall_prime_certified_adaptation [IsNoetherianRing R] {n : ℕ}
   254	    (hD : D.IsGenerator)
   255	    (h : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, ∃ r, r ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
   256	      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) :=
   257	        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away r) r
   258	      ∃ (Dr : AffCoverData C (Localization.Away r))
   259	        (A : AffAdaptation Dr
   260	          ((D.localEquations hD).pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r))
   261	            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
   262	              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) (D.localEquations hD)))),
   263	        A.IsCertified n) :
   264	    IsLocallyCertifiedAff n (D.localEquations hD) :=
   265	  -- The `_root_` qualification is load-bearing: inside `namespace ThetaGeneratorSeed` the short
   266	  -- name resolves to THIS declaration, so the general assembler must be named in full.
   267	  _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_forall_prime_certified_adaptation
   268	    (n := n) h
   269	
   270	/-- The `DivFamZarAff` class of a seed certified pointwise on the base. -/
   271	noncomputable def divFamZarAff_of_forall_prime_certified_adaptation [IsNoetherianRing R]
   272	    {n : ℕ} (hD : D.IsGenerator)
   273	    (h : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, ∃ r, r ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
   274	      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) :=
   275	        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away r) r
   276	      ∃ (Dr : AffCoverData C (Localization.Away r))
   277	        (A : AffAdaptation Dr
   278	          ((D.localEquations hD).pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r))
   279	            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
   280	              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) (D.localEquations hD)))),
   281	        A.IsCertified n) :
   282	    DivFamZarAff C R n :=
   283	  DivFamZarAff.mk (D.localEquations hD)
   284	    (isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_forall_prime_certified_adaptation hD h)
   285	
   286	/-! ## Non-vacuity, and the exact strength of the witness
   287	
   288	Trap (c) of the workspace probe catalogue (`I-0442`): a theorem whose hypotheses cannot hold
   289	jointly is vacuously true and reports clean axioms like any other, so `#print axioms` on the gate
   290	says nothing about whether it is about anything.  The inhabitation is therefore exhibited.
   291	
   292	**The caveat is inherited and must be stated here rather than only upstream.**  The gate's
   293	hypotheses are exactly the endpoint's, so the endpoint's witness inhabits them — and that witness
   294	sits at `n = 0` with an EMPTY support locus (`exists_isCertified_of_seed_of_supportLocus_empty`,
   295	`…AffSeedEndpoint.lean`).  Its own scope paragraph says what it is worth, and the same reading
   296	applies verbatim to the gate: it rules out the hypotheses contradicting each other outright, and
   297	it does **not** rule out the weaker-but-real possibility that they hold only at `n = 0`.  Read the
   298	lemma below as *"the gate is not about nothing"*, never as *"the gate is non-trivially
   299	inhabited"*.
   300	
   301	What is known about `n > 0` is unchanged by this file: the gate fires whenever the degree datum is
   302	supplied at that `n`, and nothing in the hypothesis set forces `n = 0`; supplying that datum from
   303	geometry at a specific `n > 0` is the seed layer's business.  The genuinely non-vacuous witness
   304	would need a straddling divisor, which exists over every field (spec ADDENDUM 4 §4.3) but is out
   305	of scope to formalise (§4.5 — it needs `Sym^g C`).  Cf. `DivisorFamilyAffStrict.lean`, whose
   306	strictness theorem carries the identical caveat for the identical reason. -/
   307	
   308	/-- **The gate's hypothesis set is jointly inhabited**, at the zero divisor with `n = 0`: the
   309	support locus is empty, so the `0B8B` containment holds for any affine open inside a cover member
   310	and every colength vanishes.
   311	
   312	See the section note above for exactly how much this is worth — it is a non-self-contradiction
   313	certificate, not a claim of non-trivial inhabitation. -/
   314	theorem isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_supportLocus_empty [IsProper C.hom] [IsNoetherianRing R]
   315	    (hD : D.IsGenerator)
   316	    (hempty : (D.localEquations hD).supportLocus = (∅ : Set (relCurve C R)))
   317	    {W : (relCurve C R).Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
   318	    (z₀ : relCurve C R) (hWle : W ≤ (D.localEquations hD).cover.opens z₀) :
   319	    IsLocallyCertifiedAff 0 (D.localEquations hD) :=
   320	  isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_isCertified hD
   321	    (exists_isCertified_of_seed_of_supportLocus_empty C R hD hempty hW z₀ hWle)
   322	
   323	end ThetaGeneratorSeed
   324	
   325	end AlgebraicGeometry

    10	# The carve condition for widened certified divisor families
    11	
    12	The carve condition used by the divisor classifier depends only on the two divisor windows and
    13	the local equations cutting out the divisor.  It is therefore independent of whether those
    14	equations are packaged by the old chart-typed carrier or by `CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff`.
    15	
    16	`CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff.eps_carve` records the carrier-free form needed by the widened
    17	classifier.  Its proof is the same membership argument as `divFamEps_carve`: multiplication by a
    18	section of the shift window preserves vanishing along arbitrary local equations.
    19	-/

    52	/-- The epsilon pair of every widened certified divisor family satisfies the divisor-carve
    53	condition.  No cover or chart typing enters: the assertion follows directly from the local
    54	equations defining the two windows. -/

     8	/-!
     9	# U2 as an equation between morphisms: the chart maps lie in the range of the classifier
    10	
    11	`Picard/DivRepAffPullClause.lean` reduced the whole divisor-representability chain to a
    12	single hypothesis, `DivRepChartFamily.IsChartClause U`, and `IsChartClause.of_id` showed
    13	that its `ω`-quantifier collapses to the identity point, i.e. to the DDR9-U ε-identity as
    14	`informal/w4-ddr9-worksheet.md` §3.1 states it.  That is still a *submodule* identity with
    15	a `∀`-quantifier over tower tests and framings hidden inside `IsDivRepClassify`.
    16	
    17	This file removes that quantifier.  The backward classifier `divRepClassifyZar`
    18	(`Picard/DivRepClassifyZar.lean`) is defined for **every** locally certified class over
    19	**every** affine test, unconditionally, and `isDivRepClassify_unique` says it is the
    20	*only* morphism satisfying the clause.  So the clause is not an extra property at all:
    21	
    22	> `IsDivRepClassify F₀ v` ↔ `(divRepClassifyZar … F₀).left = v`.
    23	
    24	Both directions are one line — forward is uniqueness, backward is a rewrite — and the
    25	consequence is that U2 becomes an **equation between two morphisms of schemes that both
    26	already exist**:
    27	
    28	> U2 ↔ for each pair chart `(i, j)`, `(divRepClassifyZar … (U i j)).left = ChartMap i j`.
    29	
    30	Reading off the existential, the last obligation of divisor representability is that
    31	each chart map lies in the **range** of the classifier at its own chart ring:
    32	
    33	> `divFunctor_representableBy_of_chartRange` :
    34	>   `(∀ i j, ∃ F, (divRepClassifyZar … F).left = ChartMap i j) →`
    35	>   `(divFunctor C π g).RepresentableBy DivOver`
    36	
    37	Since `divRepClassifyZar` is injective on classes (`eq_of_isDivRepClassify`,
    38	`Picard/DivRepClassifyZarSep.lean`), representability of `divFunctor` is *equivalent* to
    39	surjectivity of `divRepClassifyZar` at every affine test; what this file records is that
    40	surjectivity at the **chart rings alone** suffices.  That is the honest content: the
    41	classifier is already a bijection onto its range everywhere, and the whole remaining debt
    42	is that the finitely many chart points are hit.
    43	
    44	## Main declarations
    45	
    46	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isDivRepClassify_iff_divRepClassifyZar_left_eq` — the clause **is**
    47	  the classifier equation, in both directions.  General: no chart family, no universal
    48	  point.
    49	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivRepChartFamily.isChartClause_iff_forall_classify_eq` — U2 as a
    50	  per-chart equation of morphisms, **as an iff**, so it is a reduction and not merely a
    51	  restatement (the safeguard of inbox `I-0571`).
    52	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFunctor_representableBy_of_chartRange` — divisor
    53	  representability from range membership of the chart maps.
    54	
    55	## What this does NOT do
    56	
    57	It produces no class over a chart ring, so it clears no gate: U2 is unproved and, per
    58	roadmap `…divrep.u2`, the production of a chart class with the tautological ε remains the
    59	G-4 obligation.  What changes is what a producer has to exhibit — a class whose classifier
    60	*is* the chart map, rather than a family satisfying a quantified submodule identity.  The
    61	endpoint also still carries `hO`, `hχ` and the ambient curve instances.
    62	-/

   152	/-- **K2 — matrix presentation from a free quotient** (quotient frame convention,
   153	worksheet §0.1): a coordinate Grassmannian point over a nontrivial ring whose quotient
   154	is FREE is a matrix point.  The matrix is `LinearMap.toMatrix'` of the composite
   155	"quotient map then quotient-basis coordinates", read through the coordinate
   156	identification — its columns are the quotient-basis coordinates of the images of the
   157	standard ambient generators; no submodule-side generators are chosen. -/
   158	theorem exists_matrixPoint_eq_of_free {T : Type u} [CommRing T] [Algebra k T]
   159	    [Nontrivial T] {g r : ℕ} (x : grFunctorAff k (Fin r → k) g T)
   160	    (hfree : Module.Free T (TensorProduct k T (Fin r → k) ⧸ x.toSubmodule)) :
   161	    ∃ (X : Matrix (Fin g) (Fin r) T) (hX : Function.Surjective (matrixProj k g r T X)),
   162	      matrixPoint k g r T X hX = x := by
   163	  haveI := hfree
   164	  -- the free quotient has rank `g`: the point's own stalk-rank clause at any prime
   165	  obtain ⟨p⟩ : Nonempty (PrimeSpectrum T) := inferInstance
   166	  have hfin : Module.finrank T (TensorProduct k T (Fin r → k) ⧸ x.toSubmodule) = g := by
   167	    have h1 := x.rankAtStalk_eq p
   168	    rwa [congrFun (Module.rankAtStalk_eq_finrank_of_free
   169	      (R := T) (M := TensorProduct k T (Fin r → k) ⧸ x.toSubmodule)) p] at h1
   170	  have hcard : Fintype.card (Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex T
   171	      (TensorProduct k T (Fin r → k) ⧸ x.toSubmodule)) = g := by
   172	    rw [← Module.finrank_eq_card_chooseBasisIndex]
   173	    exact hfin
   174	  set b : Module.Basis (Fin g) T (TensorProduct k T (Fin r → k) ⧸ x.toSubmodule) :=
   175	    (Module.Free.chooseBasis T _).reindex (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hcard) with hb

   216	/-- **`IsDivRepClassify` is local on the base** — the tool this file is really about, and
   217	it mentions no chart family.  If a spanning family `f : Fin m → S` is such that every
   218	restriction of `F₀` to `Localization.Away (f t)` is classified by the corresponding
   219	restriction of `v`, then `F₀` is classified by `v`.

   221	The clause quantifies over tower tests, so both its data and its conclusion restrict: given
   222	a framing over `T`, compare with the `t`-th piece over
   223	`TensorProduct S T (Localization.Away (f t))`, where the framing pushes along the left leg
   224	(`map_window_frame_toSubmodule` at the identity tower — the `hβ` trick of
   225	`pullback_chart_divClassifyClause_compat`) and the certified representative pushes with it.

   227	pulled-back cover globalizes.

   230	known piecewise, and this lemma says knowing the clause piecewise is knowing it. -/
   231	theorem pullback_isDivRepClassify_compat {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
   232	    (F₀ : DivFamZar C S pi g)
   233	    {v : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ⟶
   234	      DivScheme k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
   235	        (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
   236	        (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm)}
   237	    {T : Type u} [CommRing T] [Algebra k T] [Algebra S T] [IsScalarTower k S T]
   238	    (GT : CertifiedDivisorFamily C T pi g)
   239	    (hGT : (DivFam.mk GT).toZar = DivFamZar.mapAlg T g F₀)
   240	    {i : (glueData k g r1).J} {j : (glueData k g r2).J}
   241	    (w : PairChartRing k g r1 g r2 i j →ₐ[k] T)

   243	      = Submodule.map (LinearMap.baseChange T b1.equivFun.toLinearMap)
   244	          (divFamEps hpi g (DivFam.mk GT)).1)
   245	    (hw2 : (Module.Grassmannian.map w (pairTautSnd k g r1 r2 i j)).toSubmodule
   246	      = Submodule.map (LinearMap.baseChange T b2.equivFun.toLinearMap)
   247	          (divFamEps hpi g (DivFam.mk GT)).2)

   260	            (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm) := by

   265	      (B := A)).toRingHom.toAlgebra

   268	      rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_def, Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_def,

   273	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
   274	  haveI : IsScalarTower S A (TensorProduct S T A) :=
   275	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
   276	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
   277	      exact Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom_comp_algebraMap)
   278	  haveI : IsScalarTower k A (TensorProduct S T A) :=
   279	    isScalarTower_left_of_isScalarTower (R₀ := S)

   281	  -- of the class restricted from `A`

   283	      = DivFamZar.mapAlg (TensorProduct S T A) g (DivFamZar.mapAlg A g F₀) := by
